d:
Puran Poli belte waqt phat jaati hai ya chipakti hai? Ye ek trick dekhiye – soft, phooli-phooli puran poli, aur puran pehle se ready!
Masala Kitchen by Poonam Devnani ki tried & tested Puran Poli recipe: chana dal ka puran, gud-chini aur lachila aata. Diwali se pehle bana kar rakh lijiye.
Soft aata: gehun aata + maida, ghee aur patakne ka tarika
Puran sahi bana hai ya nahi – chammach trick
Puran freezer mein 1 mahine tak, balloon jaisi phulane ki trick
Comment karein – aapki Puran Poli kahan phatti ya chipakti hai?
